displayGeometryOverrides.method: Image-UV mesh silhouette clips roof-edge background without editing or redistributing a new raster; porch width/posts aligned to inspected crop, conservative depth estimate.
displayGeometryOverrides.limits: Original full-resolution source absent. Baked shadows, vegetation and photographic porch perspective remain. GIS footprint, roof mass, collision and identity unchanged.
displayGeometryOverrides.photoOverlapPolicy: Reviewed S03 source contains front porch posts/beam and balcony rails. Hide their generated duplicates only after photo load; preserve slabs and failed-photo procedural fallback. Original raster and hashes unchanged.

recordingReferenceIntegration.source: User-provided October 18, 2026 driving footage, existing perspective exports; original recordings are not shipped.
recordingReferenceIntegration.rights: User requested use of their recording in this game. No CC0/public-domain or third-party redistribution license is asserted. No new external images.
recordingReferenceIntegration.runtimeUse: Two bounded sign/identity crops, a yellow No Frills wall section, the observed stone pier at 364 Water, and path/driveway tints on five previously matched residential gardens. Building and terrain geometry sources remain unchanged.
recordingReferenceIntegration.fallback: ?recordingReferences=off disables this pass; ?visuals=legacy also disables it. Missing photos retain procedural details.
recordingReferenceIntegration.limits: Reference proportions and colors are estimates under existing experimental projection and baked illumination. Parking layouts and the unlocated residential extract set remain unassigned.

recordingReferenceExpansion.source: Existing user-provided October 18 perspective exports and separately identified October 19 two-pass extracts. Original files remain outside runtime assets.
recordingReferenceExpansion.rights: Reference-only use requested by the user; no additional photos are bundled and no CC0 or third-party redistribution rights are asserted.
recordingReferenceExpansion.runtimeUse: Five verified corridor appearance additions and five existing shared ground colour defaults. Arches are limited to Showplace centre upper opening and the tall east-Water upper floor; unsupported neighbour-derived arches were removed.
recordingReferenceExpansion.fallback: ?recordingExpansion=off retains the earlier eight-site recording pass. ?recordingReferences=off and ?visuals=legacy disable this continuation too.
recordingReferenceExpansion.limits: Facade proportions and surface colours are visual approximations. The Cricket route and houses 22/24 are now matched in the separate cricketRecordingReferences section; other house IDs remain provisional. The separate October 19 residential collection is not georeferenced. Obscured, roof-only and unrecorded elevations are not reconstructed.

cricketRecordingReferences.identityEvidence: User identified the recorded orange-toy porch house as 22 Cricket Place and confirmed the Hunter Street East bridge / north Driscoll Terrace / east Cricket Place route. Official City civic parcel geometry anchors 22 and adjoining 24 to the existing OSM footprints.
cricketRecordingReferences.source: Existing user-provided October 18 perspective exports; paths, SHA256 hashes and observed details are recorded with each runtime profile.
cricketRecordingReferences.rights: User-authorized reference use in this game. No original photographs, third-party listing images or parcel data are bundled as game assets; no public-domain or general redistribution license is asserted.
cricketRecordingReferences.runtimeUse: Reference-derived brick and trim colours, two front opening layouts and simplified porch components. Source map footprints, dimensions, roof geometry, collision and identity stay unchanged.
cricketRecordingReferences.fallback: ?cricketReferences=off disables only these two houses. recordingExpansion=off, recordingReferences=off and visuals=legacy also disable them.
cricketRecordingReferences.limits: Simplified existing roof volumes remain visibly unlike the source gables. Porch and opening dimensions are visual estimates. Unknown neighbours and the separate October 19 image collection remain unassigned. Trial lawn/path strips were rejected after image review because they formed arbitrary rectangles and stopped short of a known sidewalk endpoint; the existing ground remains unchanged.
